meta.title: Intro and Full Article Images
meta.description: Joomla with the guided tour "Intro and Full Article Images".

steps.sql:
UPDATE `#__guidedtours` SET `autostart` = 0; INSERT INTO `#__guidedtours` (`title`, `uid`, `description`, `ordering`, `extensions`, `url`, `created`, `created_by`, `modified`, `modified_by`, `published`, `language`, `note`, `access`, `autostart`) VALUES ('Intro and Full Article Images', 'joomlaguide-intro-image-full-article-image', '

Every article has two optional images: an Intro Image, shown in lists of articles such as a category blog, and a Full Article Image, shown at the top of the article itself.

The playground has already put the images of the tutorial\'s Setup in the media folder Astronomy, so you do not need to upload them. You start by adding the two articles of the Setup.

This tour follows the tutorial 4.3 Intro and Full Article Images of the Joomla User Guide.

It opens and shows what you can do there.

Besides Crab Nebula, the category Astronomy gets two more articles. Click New.

', 30, 'right', '.view-article:has(#jform_title[value="Andromeda Galaxy"]) #fieldset-image-intro', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-intro-image-full-article-image'), 'Full Article Image', '

  1. At Intro Image, click Select.
  2. In the window, open Astronomy, click Jupiter_Intro.jpg and click Select.

', 35, 'right', '.view-article:has(#jform_title[value="Jupiter"]) #fieldset-image-intro', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-intro-image-full-article-image'), 'Full Article Image', '

  3. In its Image Description (Alt Text), type Jupiter and the JUICE spacecraft.
  4. In Caption, type The Jupiter Icy Moons Explorer (JUICE), an interplanetary spacecraft created by the European Space Agency (ESA).

Then click Next.

', 36, 'right', '.view-article:has(#jform_title[value="Jupiter"]) #fieldset-image-full', 2, 3, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-intro-image-full-article-image'), 'Save the article', '

Click Save & Close.

', 37, 'bottom', '.view-article:has(#jform_title[value="Jupiter"]) #save-group-children-save .button-save', 2, 1, 'administrator/index.php?option=com_content&view=article&layout=edit', CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(), 0, 1, '*', '', NULL), ((SELECT `id` FROM `#__guidedtours` WHERE `uid` = 'joomlaguide-intro-image-full-article-image'), 'Well done!', '

  • The blog shows the intro images.
  • Andromeda Galaxy shows the same picture, larger, as full article image.
  • Jupiter has a different full article image, with a caption.
  • Crab Nebula has only an intro image: on its own page you see just the images in its text.
